from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperRelation(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection and its outbound references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperRelation]
